title: PreToolUse (Bash) hook input — fields consumed by pre_bash_guard.py
description: Claude Code delivers a larger payload on stdin; this schema documents only the fields this hook reads. Unknown fields are ignored. Malformed JSON is treated as 'do not block' by design.

command.description: The shell command about to run. Matched against the blocklist regex: rm -rf | git push --force | git push -f.

x-exit-codes.2: block the tool call; stderr is fed back to the model as the reason
